Utility Class Drones are used to fulfil a particular function, from milk production to waste processing.

Contains the following units:
-LACTOSELASS: Used to produce the ability-granting liquid LassLiquid. Available for adoption after retirement.
-SNATCHSTATION: Designed for high usage sexual desire processing. Fluid drains linked to digestive system.
-POTTYPRINCESS: Waste processing drone able to digest 99% of liquid/solid biological waste.

Renders and commissioned works from the creator IBEX-CG: https://twitter.com/IBEXCEO

UPDATED March 2026
Pictures will have most recently uploaded pieces first and then previous pieces sorted into groups by drone type.

These collections could not be made without the assistance of https://x.com/IBEXDroneMeat who takes the time to collect all drones produced and categorize them.
